title: rpg-factory delivery pipeline status (scripts/factory-pipeline.py status --json)
description: How far each task of a plan got, derived from git and the recorded verdicts; how a new lead session resumes a run.

valid.description: false when `validate` reports an error; tasks is then empty.

phase.description: pending: nothing started; implementing: task branch (and worktree) without commits; candidate: commits not reviewed at their HEAD; reviewed: a review verdict on the HEAD (PASS or FAIL); integrated: reviewed PASS and contained in the integration branch; qa: QA PASS on a commit containing it.

sha.description: The task's candidate commit (task branch HEAD, or the integration HEAD in a no-worktree repo).

children.description: Leftover Orca child worktrees of the task worktree (branch or directory `<task branch>--*`); each also gets a note: merge it into the task branch, then `orca worktree rm --worktree path:<child>`.

merged.description: The child branch is contained in the task branch.

next.description: The command the lead runs next for this task; null while it waits.

lead_report.description: The task lead's durable `report` record (`<task>__lead-report.json`), the same facts as the `lead report:` note; null when there is none (an Orca 'task done' message alone is only a note).

at.description: When the lead recorded it (UTC, as written); null when the record has no time.

sha.description: The full commit the report is for.

summary.description: The report's first line as stored (at most 200 characters).

current.description: The report counts for the task HEAD: its commit is the HEAD (or, in a no-worktree repo in the integrated or qa phase, an ancestor of it); false is the note's `(stale: task HEAD is <sha10>)`.

ready_for_pr.description: The `READY_FOR_PR:` note as a field, computed with it: null when no such note applies (a tier XS plan, or a phase before candidate).

ready.description: Lead report, PASS review and PASS QA at the task HEAD, nothing stale and no subtask FAIL.

missing.description: The first missing thing the note names (`READY_FOR_PR: no (<missing>)`); null when ready.

integration_children.description: Leftover Orca child worktrees of each repo's integration checkout (integration QA or a helper session: branch or directory `<topic>--*`, or any name whose Orca lineage parent is the integration checkout), listed once per repo. Merge a child's commits into the integration branch, then remove it at once with `orca worktree rm --worktree path:<child>`; `cleanup` names each as "child of integration:<repo>".

merged.description: The child branch is contained in the integration branch.

note.description: Cleanup guidance: merge it (unless merged), then the `orca worktree rm` command.

ready_wave.description: First wave (1-based) with a task not yet integrated.

ready.description: Pending tasks whose dependencies are met: dispatch them now.

next.description: Plan-level commands (validate when invalid, gate when every task has QA).

slots.description: Test slots (`<state dir>/locks/run-all-slots/<n>/`, written by tests/run-all.sh) held by a run in one of the plan's checkouts, one entry per held slot, the same entries as `cleanup --json`; empty when none (and for an invalid plan). Always present in `status --json` output; optional so an older output still validates. Read-only: the user decides, the run never stops a holder. The stderr `Slots:` lines carry the same facts as text.

slot.description: The slot directory name (a number as tests/run-all.sh writes it).

pid.description: The holder's PID as the slot's pid file names it (an MSYS PID on Windows).

winpid.description: The holder's Windows PID; empty when the slot has none.

checkout.description: The checkout the run holds the slot for.

started.description: When the run took the slot (UTC, as written); empty when unknown.

alive.description: Whether the holder process runs: null when the process listing failed or there is no usable PID.

progress.description: What the run last reported in the slot's progress file; null when it has none yet (no file, or no check in it).

check.description: The suite or check the run last reported.

result.description: Its result as written (PASS, FAIL, running, ...); empty when missing.

updated.description: When the run last updated the file (UTC, %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ as written); empty when missing.

age_seconds.description: Seconds since `updated`; null when it does not parse. A live run keeps it small, an orphan does not.

model_scope_widen.description: The plan's valid model scope widenings (`model_scope_widen` entries that pass the model policy; invalid ones are left out, also for an invalid plan), in plan order; empty when none. Always present in `status --json` output, also for an invalid plan. Optional like `models` and `slots`: the `status` command adds these three around the status core, whereas the core sets every required field (the per-task `lead_report` and `ready_for_pr` included) on each output. The stderr `model scope widening:` lines carry the same `text`.

text.description: The line status prints for it: `<agent> <model> [<efforts>] (basis <basis>: <reason>)`.
